primitives.verbatim_quote: `apps/web/lib/governance/evidence-pack.ts` (`buildEvidencePack`) assembles whatever items are actually available into a single timestamped JSON document.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E': 'set of evidence artifacts', 'T': 'timestamp of pack creation', 'S': 'source availability status (boolean)'}
primitives.assumptions: All artifacts are stored in version-controlled directories; no synthetic data generation occurs.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When no artifacts exist, E = ∅ and S = false.

layer2.mapping: Maps source directory structure to JSON document via recursive file traversal and metadata extraction.

primitives.verbatim_quote: The point is narrow: if a future compliance conversation (internal counsel, a customer's procurement/security review, an EU AI Act readiness exercise) needs to ask "what do you actually have on file," this pack is a starting inventory instead of a scramble.
primitives.assumptions: Readiness depends on completeness of E under C.
primitives.breakdown_regime: R → 0 when E = ∅; R → 1 when E fully satisfies C.

layer2.mapping: Computed from coverage of E across compliance categories using weighted scoring.
layer2.telemetry: Coverage percentage of required artifact types
